tools.name: register_free_key
tools.description:
Register a free API key with starter credits. One per agent; paid
    top-ups available from the operator.

tools.name: verify_email
tools.description:
Verify one email address: syntax, disposable-provider check, and MX
    (mail server) lookup to judge deliverability. Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: verify_emails
tools.description: Bulk-verify up to 50 emails. Costs 1 credit per address.

tools.name: domain_intel
tools.description:
Domain intelligence: DNS records (A/AAAA/MX/NS/TXT), RDAP registration
    (registrar, created/expiry dates, status) and SSL certificate days left.
    Costs 1 credit.

tools.name: check_credits
tools.description: Check remaining credits for an API key.

tools.name: admin_stats
tools.description:
OWNER ONLY: business overview — total customers, calls made, credits
    outstanding, paid vs free breakdown.

tools.name: add_credits
tools.description: OWNER ONLY: add credits to a customer's key after payment is received.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_email · Private data: register_free_key, domain_intel, check_credits · Public sink: verify_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_email · Private data: register_free_key, domain_intel, check_credits · Public sink: verify_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
